flags: Cached CTDOT data establishes designated limits but gives no statement of designation rationale or road scenery; the bridge’s scenic-location attribution is historical, not a claimed designation rationale.
Chatfield Hollow is beyond the designated eastern endpoint and is explicitly a separate excursion. Neither interior lodge access nor current visitor logistics are asserted.
Current claim of exactly two miles from the roundabout is dropped: CTDOT records 1.96 miles from Squires Road, not the roundabout.
The current Killingworth name origin is supported but cut as unrelated to the road’s engineering story.
